name: ATOD
description: ATOD is a benchmark and synthetic dialogue generation pipeline designed to evaluate agentic task-oriented dialogue systems. It captures advanced TOD characteristics such as multi-goal coordination, dependency management, memory, adaptability, and proactivity, with a holistic evaluation framework supporting fine-grained metrics and reproducible offline and online evaluation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark/pipeline from the ATOD paper; it is not yet broadly adopted but targets an important gap in agentic task-oriented dialogue evaluation.
notes: Includes an agentic memory-based evaluator; supports comprehensive assessment of task completion, agentic capability, and response quality.
